title: Minimum contacts
summary: Minimum contacts describe the forum connections needed to make an assertion of personal jurisdiction compatible with the due-process standard developed in International Shoe. The inquiry examines the quality, nature, and legal significance of the connections.
notes: Contacts are not a mechanical count. A plaintiff’s location or unilateral travel does not automatically supply the defendant’s connection, and consent-based jurisdiction raises a separate route discussed in Mallory.

sections.Meaning: Minimum contacts describe the forum connections needed to make an assertion of personal jurisdiction compatible with the due-process standard developed in International Shoe. The inquiry examines the quality, nature, and legal significance of the connections.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the defendant’s own activities, the forum, and the relationship of those activities to the claim. Distinguish a claim connected to forum activity from a request to hear any claim against the defendant. Then consider the relevant fairness analysis.
